plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for FireEye / Trellix NX/EX/CMS security appliances (enterprise PEN 25597). In addition to standard IF-MIB interface metrics, it collects HOST-RESOURCES processor load and FireEye system health TruthValues for temperature, power supply and fan. Temperature is reported as a health state only; no numeric Celsius reading is exposed.
name: Firewall

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of each FireEye / Trellix processor (HOST-RESOURCES-MIB hrProcessorLoad), reported as a 0-100 percentage. Values outside 0-100 are dropped. The headline query averages cores by instance.

metrics.name: device_temperature_state
metrics.description: Overall temperature health of the FireEye / Trellix appliance (feTemperatureIsHealthy TruthValue). true(1) maps to normal and false(2) maps to abnormal; any other value is dropped. No numeric Celsius reading is available.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: Overall fan health of the FireEye / Trellix appliance (feFanOverallIsHealthy TruthValue). true(1) maps to normal and false(2) maps to abnormal; any other value is dropped.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: Overall power-supply health of the FireEye / Trellix appliance (fePowerSupplyOverallIsHealthy TruthValue). true(1) maps to normal and false(2) maps to abnormal; any other value is dropped.
